capabilities: Extract highlights, underlines, strikethroughs, squiggles, sticky notes and free text from PDFs inside and outside the vault
Filter extraction by page range, creation date and highlight color
Format annotations with per-type templates and variables, including moving annotation tags into note properties
Group annotations by folder, file, date and topic with optional headings
Write annotations to the current note, a new shared note, or separate notes with template-based names, subfolders and PDF-bookmark filing
disambiguation: Extracts PDF annotations (highlights, comments, free text), not PDF text or page content generally.
extras: Beta and previous versions can be installed through the BRAT plugin; the listing carries a note that it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: The plugin started as a fork of Extract PDF Annotations by Franz Achermann and Florian Stöckl
motivation: The author writes: "This plugin helps me in my research and I use it in my teaching".
problem: Obsidian lets you read PDFs but offers no way to pull the annotations you made in them out into Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: started as a fork of Extract PDF Annotations by Franz Achermann and Florian Stöckl
built on ideas from Alexis Rondeau's plugin

summary: PDF annotation extractor that imports highlights, sticky notes and free text from PDFs into vault notes with templates and grouping.
